train_eval_split.unit: source_crop (all three axis edges of a location travel together)
train_eval_split.method: Deterministic hash rank of source_id; no label-dependent assignment
train_eval_split.eval_holdout_rule: Eval sources and their edges MUST NOT be used for loss, early stopping, checkpoint selection, or hyperparameter decisions

loss.name: masked_affinity_bce
loss.notes: Sparse supervision only on labeled +1 faces from promoted GT; unlabeled voxels ignored

model_config.trainer_entrypoint_intended: tools/train_dvid_adaptation_rocm.py (or successor that consumes the frozen PGT002 manifest without altering this contract)
model_config.initialization: Document exact checkpoint path at run start in the run receipt; if resuming a prior Megaphragma adaptation checkpoint, record its sha256 in the run receipt

checkpoint_selection_rule.definition: Mean of (SAME accuracy @ threshold 0.5) and (DIFFERENT accuracy @ threshold 0.5) on eval edges only
checkpoint_selection_rule.selection: Choose the checkpoint with maximum primary_metric; ties → lowest training step
forbidden: Selecting checkpoints using validation_002 / batch_001 / smoke / discovery labels
Retuning threshold on the eval set after seeing final numbers for the purpose of claiming a pass

reported_on_eval_only: mean predicted affinity on SAME edges
mean predicted affinity on DIFFERENT edges

pass_fail_gates_for_this_first_run.GATE_A_eval_completeness: All frozen eval edges scored exactly once
pass_fail_gates_for_this_first_run.GATE_B_both_classes_scored: Eval contains ≥1 SAME and ≥1 DIFFERENT (already true at freeze)
pass_fail_gates_for_this_first_run.GATE_C_better_than_constant_same: balanced_edge_accuracy_at_0p5 > accuracy of constant SAME predictor on the same eval edges
pass_fail_gates_for_this_first_run.GATE_E_no_eval_leakage: Run receipt proves eval sources absent from training batches

evaluation_metrics_and_gates.pass_rule: All of GATE_A–E must pass for AFFINITY_TRAIN_PGT002_001_PASS; otherwise AFFINITY_TRAIN_PGT002_001_FAIL
evaluation_metrics_and_gates.note_on_supervision_sufficiency: Whether 24 promoted edges are sufficient for downstream segmentation is a separate prospective gate after this first controlled run; it is NOT a Batch 002 QC modification and NOT grounds to alter these frozen train gates post hoc

prohibited_during_run: Using eval edges in the loss
Early stopping / model selection on non-eval or excluded corpora
Changing split, seeds, architecture, threshold, or pass/fail gates after seeing eval results
